datasets.title: S6 2017 hemispherical spectral albedo (Cook et al. 2020 archive)
datasets.site: S6, SW Greenland ablation area (about 1000 m a.s.l.; one site)
datasets.spectral_quantity: hemispherical spectral albedo (upward/downward irradiance ratio, cosine receptor)
datasets.geometry_illumination: natural sky at about solar noon; sky condition and exact time per plot not recorded in the file
datasets.documented_uncertainty: about +-0.01-0.02 (not stated per plot); source docs/data_manifest.md; the publication was NOT re-read here
datasets.measured_components: none in this file; algal counts for 47 of the 87 plots (S6_2017_counts)
datasets.colocation: the 47 SB plots with counts also have an albedo and an HCRF spectrum (same plot IDs); 40 plots (tag 'S') have albedo only
datasets.temporal_match: same day and plot; counts are surface samples taken at the plot, albedo is a footprint average
ancestry: denominators of the ARF/k prior (50 of 87 plots); H1 albedo target; see docs/data_use_register.md
the S6 mean dust loading and the radius prior are campaign-level information from the same campaign
datasets.leakage_notes: any S6 evaluation of a model whose k prior or dust prior came from S6 is not independent of S6

datasets.title: S6 2017 nadir HCRF (same plots)
datasets.spectral_quantity: HCRF, nadir (ASD FieldSpec, bare fibre; directional, NOT albedo)
datasets.geometry_illumination: nadir view; solar zenith not recorded in the file
datasets.colocation: same plot IDs as the counts (47/47)
ancestry: numerators of the ARF/k prior (29 of 51 ARF columns)
sigma and radius prior of earlier retrievals (docs/data_use_register.md)
datasets.leakage_notes: HCRF is directional; converting to albedo needs k = HCRF/albedo, which was itself estimated from these plots

datasets.title: S6 2017 glacier-algae cell counts (47 plots)
datasets.geometry_illumination: surface sample, top about 2 cm, about 1 m2 plot
datasets.documented_uncertainty: Poisson on cells counted (1/sqrt N); 5 zero counts; counted volume of zero counts not recorded
datasets.measured_components: glacier-algal cells only. NO per-plot mineral dust, black carbon, cryoconite, pigment or ice-structure measurement
datasets.colocation: plot-level, matching albedo and HCRF IDs
ancestry: evaluation target of earlier held-out and H1 tests
datasets.leakage_notes: reused as an evaluation set before; not untouched
endpoints_available: algal abundance (component truth for the algal term only)

datasets.title: ARF (HCRF/albedo) and published BioSNICAR retrievals for S6 2017
datasets.spectral_quantity: ARF = HCRF/albedo (derived); retrievals are MODEL OUTPUT (algae_cells_inv_model_S2 etc.)
datasets.colocation: 29 of 51 ARF columns are count plots
ancestry: k prior for every physics retrieval in this repository
datasets.leakage_notes: published retrievals are a REFERENCE, never a truth target; the fitting procedure that produced them was not verified here

datasets.title: Southern Greenland 2021 HCRF spectra and counts (Chevrollier et al. 2023 / 2026 data)
datasets.source: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.18826013 (HCRF netCDF, as recorded in data/empirical/SOURCES.md) and Chevrollier et al. 2023 Table S4 (parsed from the supplement text)
datasets.site: southern Greenland (site name not recorded in the repository files; one site)
datasets.spectral_quantity: HCRF, nadir (ASD FieldSpec 4; directional, NOT albedo)
datasets.geometry_illumination: nadir; solar zenith per spectrum in Table S4 (sza_deg)
datasets.documented_uncertainty: counts: number counted not published (log-normal SD 0.10 dex assumed in earlier work); scraped depth 1-6 cm not recorded per sample
datasets.measured_components: ice-algal and snow-algal cells (Table S4). No dust, BC, cryoconite or pigment per sample
datasets.colocation: 20 spectra with matching Table S4 rows
ancestry: BioSNICAR's default ice-algal optics (Chevrollier 2023) were measured on algae from this research programme
used as the PRIMARY target of held-out_v2 and for sigma/tau of the reverse fold (docs/data_use_register.md)
Table S4 also carries the authors' own fitted model parameters (model_density, model_reff_um): fits to these spectra
datasets.leakage_notes: not untouched; 6 Table S4 rows are S6-2017 plots without spectra in this file

datasets.title: Finse (southern Norway) snowfield HCRF, 180 spectra (snowlaps dataset)
datasets.site: Finse, southern Norway (60.57 N, 7.46 E); snow, not glacier ice
datasets.spectral_quantity: HCRF (ASD FieldSpec 4, 25 degree foreoptic, relative to Spectralon), treated as albedo by the authors
datasets.geometry_illumination: nadir; SZA 38-58 degrees (metadata); 88 of 180 spectra flagged diffuse (SZA set to 50 by snowlaps)
datasets.units: dimensionless; RAW values include non-physical numbers in atmospheric absorption bands
datasets.measured_components: NONE (no LAP concentration measured; black carbon presence not measured)
ancestry: reference data for reproducing the snowlaps retrieval only
datasets.leakage_notes: snow substrate, red snow algae: NOT a glacier-ice evaluation set

datasets.title: Williamson et al. 2020 S6 2016 pigments, MACs, HPLC spectra (calibration data)
datasets.spectral_quantity: in vivo absorption of algal pigments (per mass, phenol-equivalent) and counts, S6 2016
datasets.notes: laboratory; the only MEASURED variability of algal pigment optics in the repository (53 extracts, one site)

datasets.title: Measured specific surface area of bubbly ice
PROMICE KAN_L and KAN_M hourly (L3), 2016-2023
datasets.source: GEUS Dataverse doi:10.22008/FK2/IW73UU (live L3 product, downloaded 2026-10-09)
datasets.version: dataset version 40; sha256 recorded in data/promice_raw/SHA256SUMS
datasets.site: KAN_L (about 650 m) and KAN_M (about 1270 m), SW Greenland
datasets.spectral_quantity: broadband shortwave up/down radiation and albedo (radiometer); NO spectral information
datasets.geometry_illumination: hourly means; tilt-corrected only where dsr_cor exists (KAN_M none in 2019/2021)
datasets.notes: untracked read-only data in the main checkout; hashes taken from this run
ancestry: forcing and validation endpoint of H2/H4 (frozen protocol); KAN_M also used for clear-sky transmissivity and chi

datasets.title: PROMBIO ice-algae counts under PROMICE radiometers (GEUS)
datasets.spectral_quantity: n/a (counts); station albedo is the radiative endpoint
datasets.measured_components: ice-algal cells per mL; strata incl. 'under radiometer', 'dark ice' (targeted, not an area mean)
datasets.colocation: sample under the radiometer; coordinates are STATION positions
datasets.roles_frozen: docs/new_data_inventory.md: 2021 and 2023 development; 2024 final test, withheld (5 station-days; 2 usable after exclusions in H5)
datasets.independent_glaciers: station-days across several stations; usable test n is very small
ancestry: 2024 file header and some rows were seen during an import audit (docs/new_data_inventory.md)
